dimension_description: This scale stores precision as relative uncertainty or fractional error. Smaller values mean higher precision, so it is inverted compared with everyday language like “more precise.” That inversion is worth it because relative uncertainty is much more coherent and log-friendly than a vague notion of accuracy.
